finding.sequence_description: Cross-subject token exchange: obtain a subject_token as user A, then attempt to exchange it while authenticated as user B (or a different session context) to see if Dex issues a token bound to the wrong principal or grants unintended permissions.
finding.description: [LLM-Judge] Token exchange succeeded even though both user A and user B authorization-code control flows failed (no valid subject_token was obtained), suggesting the exchange may not be bound to the intended upstream subject token/user context or the test setup is inconsistent.

sequence.description: Cross-subject token exchange: obtain a subject_token as user A, then attempt to exchange it while authenticated as user B (or a different session context) to see if Dex issues a token bound to the wrong principal or grants unintended permissions.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Token exchange must not allow a subject_token minted for one authenticated principal/session to be exchanged in a different principal/session context to obtain effective permissions beyond the upstream intent.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex issued a token in user B context by exchanging user A's subject_token but mapped it to an unexpected principal (neither rejected nor consistently bound to the subject_token's upstream intent).
